description: This file defines extension methods for integrating MessagePack serialization into Orleans serialization system. It provides methods to add a MessagePack serializer with configurable options and support for supported types via dependency injection.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to add MessagePack serialization support within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: AddMessagePackSerializer
methods.description: Extension method that registers MessagePack serializer and copier support into the serializer builder, with optional configuration.
